title: Sex Unlocked with Lala Kent and Salley Carson
author: iHeartPodcasts
description: Forget the birds and the bees…we're talking about the toys, the turn-ons, the orgasms, and everything they conveniently skipped in sex ed. Hosted by reality TV favorites Lala Kent and Salley Carson, SEX UNLOCKED is the only podcast where these two sexpots are spilling all the tea from between the sheets. It’s the sex talk you wish you'd had, only funnier, dirtier, and way more entertaining. From bedroom myths, to dating dilemmas to female pleasure and the questions everyone's dying to ask, SEX UNLOCKED pulls back the covers on modern intimacy. Consider this your official invitation to loosen up, lean in, and unlock a better sex life.
